item.title: All gritting routes to be treated Monday and Tuesday
item.description: Donegal County Council have advice that all winter maintenance designated gritting routes will be treated from 7pm Monday evening and again from 6am Tuesday morning. This comes as Met Éireann forecasts temperatures could drop to -3 degrees this evening in generally clear conditions. All road users are asked to assume no road is ice free.
